Multi-Touch Attribution Software that Works for Any Marketing Mix
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx is a software platform used by enterprise marketers and agencies as the foundation of performance-based measurement. Impartial multi-touch attribution omni-channel insights give brands the confidence to make better marketing decisions.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Multi-Touch Attribution Software that Works for Any Marketing Mix
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx is a software platform used by enterprise marketers and agencies as the foundation of performance-based measurement. Impartial multi-touch attribution omni-channel insights give brands the confidence to make better marketing decisions.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
About LeadsRx
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx is a leading software platform for marketing attribution that has helped more than 5,000 global and local brands and agencies increase marketing performance. All software products from LeadsRx leverage our Universal Pixel™, which captures anonymous, first-party data about your prospects and customers. Place the pixel directly on your website or use any tag manager. Once you do, the pixel immediately begins learning about marketing programs without the need to re-tag advertising.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Our Attribution Solutions
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx Privacy Studio™
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx Privacy Studio™ is a framework that establishes a Data Clean Room and puts IT teams in control of where and how collected data is stored. Corporate policy for privacy, user consent, and access become cornerstones of the system with IT squarely at the helm.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore Our Privacy Studio Solution
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx Attribution™
 
 
 
 
 
 
Today’s eCommerce and B2B companies rely on multi-touch attribution (MTA) to evaluate campaigns across all channels, throughout the entire sales funnel, and without bias.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore Our MTA Solution
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx Journey™
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer journey analytics (CJA) provides insight into individual consumer behavior while finding commonalities across audiences and cohorts.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore Our CJA Solution

Marketing attribution is critical for all marketing organizations, and that’s why a great Customer Success team is essential. At LeadsRx, we are proud of our NPS score, which is more than double the average for a SaaS B2B vendor.

Digital
LeadsRx uses a proprietary Universal Pixel™ that captures 100% of in-bound digital traffic to your website no matter where it comes from.
 
 

 
Learn More

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
Broadcast Radio
The LeadsRx approach provides an off-the-shelf omni-channel solution for evaluating the performance of TV and radio advertising in conjunction with all other marketing channels.
 
 

 
Learn More

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
Streaming Audio
Our cross-channel attribution provides data about how your OTT, CTV, and podcast campaigns are performing, individually and in conjunction with other channels, to drive customer engagement. Point solutions, like those for podcasts, cannot provide an impartial, holistic view.
 
 

 
Learn More

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
Linear TV
We also use MTA to identify how ALL channels are contributing to customer journeys – digital paid and organic search, social, mobile, trade shows, direct mail, inbound calls, and more.
 
 

 
Learn More

 

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
CTV/OTT
Streaming advertising is incorporated into the attribution data and insights with all other marketing channels to provide a complete view of the overall customer journey. See how OTT/CTV ads contribute to that journey. Specifically within the streaming realm, we’ll measure:
Impressions and visits to advertiser websites
Long-lead conversions influenced by ads
Website lift due to ad exposure
Segmentation on dimensions such as creative, ad position, show, duration
Segmented ROI analysis
 
 

 
Learn More

The Role of Attribution in Account-Based Marketing (ABM)
 
 
 
In ABM, attribution isn’t just about credit—it’s a key part of your strategy for understanding the journey an account takes. You can trace how someone discovered your brand, what sparked interest, and which actions helped build internal support. For example, a webinar...

Improve Marketing Performance
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx marketing attribution solutions put the power of impartial data and insights in the hands of marketers
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Two Products to Power Persistent Marketing
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx helps brands and agencies improve marketing performance by leveraging multi-touch attribution (MTA), customer journey analytics (CJA), and impartial insights drawn from all of that amazing marketing attribution data. With the right technology, marketers have the confidence they need to optimize campaigns, improve return on ad spend (ROAS), decrease customer acquisition costs, and improve customer lifetime value. We do this with two core products:
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx Attribution™
 
 
 
 
 
 
Impartial, cross-channel attribution provides marketers with basic conversion tracking to know what’s working and what’s not.
 
 
Request a Demo
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Connecting the dots between marketing touchpoints and conversions, LeadsRx Attribution™covers a broad range of marketing programs and events. See which of these touchpoints, or combination of them, result in lower acquisition costs and higher ROAS:
Digital impressions and clicks
Linear TV and broadcast radio exposure
Podcast downloads and streams
OTT impressions
Offline, in-person events, and sales
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx Journey™
 
 
 
 
 
 
With built-in identity resolution, LeadsRx captures each touchpoint along the path-to-purchase.
 
 
Request a Demo
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx has built its own identity graph over many years, now with more than 2 billion identities across devices, browsers, and apps. This makes identity resolution native to LeadsRx without the need for external, third-party solutions. Discover:
Customer journeys anonymously
Optional data enrichment with opted-in, first-party identities
Paths-to-purchase for individual customers showing costs, revenue, and lifetime value
Key metrics for common paths and average time to convert
Cohort support using demographic data

Utilize the products that work for you
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx offers a powerful platform that uses data and insights from multi-touch attribution and customer journey analytics to increase marketing performance. Businesses, brands, and agencies that use LeadsRx software and services can reduce customer acquisition costs, improve lifetime value, and reduce wasted ad spend – all in a privacy-safe environment.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LeadsRx Attribution™
 
 
 
 
 
 
Evaluate campaign performance across touchpoints and channels with multi-touch attribution.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
R

Understand how consumers build relationships with your brand with customer journey analytics.

All products come with outstanding customer service
 
 
 
 
 
 
The LeadsRx Customer Care Team prides itself on helping you get up to speed quickly but carefully. They familiarize you and your team with the product, walk you through what to do and how to do it, and provide continual and ongoing support.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Onboarding Services
 
 
 
 
 
 
We make your onboarding experience as easy as possible to get you up and running with confidence.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Ask the Expert
 
 
 
 
 
 
We schedule one-on-one Q&A sessions with a LeadsRx data analyst who provides tailored input and insights.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Insights Review
 
 
 
 
 
 
We go beyond collecting the data. We help you make sense of and draw impartial insights from it.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Premium Support
 
 
 
 
 
 
We provide additional, personalized education and guidance on product capabilities, reporting, and insights.

Attribution is marketing gold. LeadsRx is our secret weapon.
 
Craig Harrison

Frequently Asked Questions
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Are integrations included with subscriptions?
 
Yes, LeadsRx does not charge for our established integrations.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Is API access extra?
 
No, LeadsRx includes API access with all subscriptions.
 
 
 
 
 
 
How long does it take to get up and running with LeadsRx, and what level of technical resource do I need to commit during implementation and onboarding?
 
Though data flow begins right away with the placement of our Universal Pixel technology, you will be guided through an onboarding process with our team of attribution specialists over your first four weeks. This includes a discovery period in week one; data ingestion during week 2; quality assurance testing in week 3; and training on use of your LeadsRx dashboard and turning the analytics into actionable insights. The technology is plug-and-play; and our onboarding team walks you through each step of onboarding. We also provide 30- and 90-day check-ins; and our customer care team is always available to help and answer questions.
 
 
 
 
 
 
What is the minimum level of traffic/conversions/ad spend needed before investment in LeadsRx makes sense?
 
There is no hard and fast rule here. We help our customers solve complex challenges. The greater the challenge, the greater the value we bring to the table. Generally speaking, if you leverage more than a couple of paid advertising channels, and/or exercise an annual advertising budget of $100,000, or even into the millions, we should talk.
 
 
 
 
 
 
What if I am planning on leveraging a brand-new medium in the future? Will measuring additional channels cost me more? And is there support available to help me get started with these new efforts in LeadsRx?
 
We encourage adding to your marketing mix, and the analytics data will tell you what is working and what is not. In fact, if you are exploring additional channels in the near future, it’s a great time to get an attribution solution in place. Peter Drucker would advise, “you can’t manage what you can’t measure.” It does not cost any more to measure more channels, and our team is available to help you measure any and all channels. Bring it on!
 
 
 
 
 
 
Does it matter how many users I intend to provide access to my LeadsRx account?
 
The more the merrier. If you have individual sales and marketing staff who can benefit from leveraging insights from marketing analytics, by all means give them the power to do so.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Is there a handy guide listing marketing terms all marketers should know?
 
There sure is. See our 
marketing terminology blog.
